artifacts.summary: Twelve-phase T-arrival substrate refactor: adds the arrival-pruned trans datum and a lift closure field to SharingSkeleton, moves Thread.step and (C1')'s untl/snce clauses onto trans across both the Formula and PlusFormula sides, lands the untl-side incompleteness first and both gate families last, and keeps the C2 axiom baseline and theorem-index rows in step at every phase boundary.

memory_candidates.content: Keeping a large Lean substrate refactor green at every phase boundary: when a structure's defining relation must change (here SharingSkeleton's Thread.step moving from share (u+1) to a new trans datum), do not flip the definition and then repair consumers. Instead (1) land the hard new lemmas free-standing over explicitly-passed raw data first, so they need no structure change; (2) add the new structure fields plus every producer as one pre-declared atomic-batch phase, discharging the new proof obligation with the step-1 lemmas; (3) introduce a derived projection lemma (thread_share_succ) that is definitionally the OLD field, and rewrite every consumer to go through it while the old meaning still holds -- this phase is behaviour-preserving and green; (4) flip the definition, redefining the projection lemma as the new field's second component, so no consumer needs a second edit. Steps 3 and 4 split what would otherwise be one unavoidably red edit across many files into one green phase plus one small definition-site-only phase. The same shape applies to any refactor where a widely-consumed field weakens.

user_decision.question: Task 694 prescribes the trans datum this plan implements as a strict subset (no arrival pruning, no closure field, no untl-side result, no gate families). Both research rounds recommend folding it in. How should task 694 be disposed of?
options: Abandon task 694 as superseded by task 696's plan
Re-scope task 694 to the deferred exact-closure work (LiftWindow, liftable_of_liftWindow, Decidable LiftWindow), which this plan lists as a non-goal
Leave task 694 as it stands and accept the duplicated work
user_decision.recommended: Re-scope task 694 to the deferred exact-closure work (LiftWindow, liftable_of_liftWindow, Decidable LiftWindow), which this plan lists as a non-goal
